requestStatuses.label: Submitted
requestStatuses.description: The resident request has been received and is awaiting agency triage.

requestStatuses.label: Accepted
requestStatuses.description: The agency has accepted the request into its operating queue.

requestStatuses.label: In Review
requestStatuses.description: Agency staff are reviewing eligibility, evidence, or service requirements.

requestStatuses.label: In Progress
requestStatuses.description: Work has moved from review into active service resolution.

requestStatuses.label: Completed
requestStatuses.description: The requested service or eligibility action has been completed.

requestStatuses.label: Needs Follow-Up
requestStatuses.description: The request needs additional resident or agency follow-up.

requestStatuses.label: Cancelled
requestStatuses.description: The request is no longer active.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Intake
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The service task is being prepared for assignment.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Assigned
serviceTaskStatuses.description: An in-state service team or center owns the task.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Scheduled
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The service task has been placed on the operating schedule.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Dispatched
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The assigned team has been dispatched from the service center.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: In Progress
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The assigned team is actively working the service task.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Field Resolution Underway
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The assigned in-state team is actively resolving the request in the resident's service area.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Completed
serviceTaskStatuses.description: The service task has been completed.

serviceTaskStatuses.label: Blocked
serviceTaskStatuses.description: An issue is preventing the service task from moving forward.
